releaseNotes: Tabs now slide directly to their destination without exposing intermediate pages.
Android system navigation and keyboard insets keep the message composer consistently visible.
Voice messages display seekable Telegram-style waveforms with live playback progress.
Old and new account conversations remain distinct, with stable saved and pinned chat spacing.
Messages can be deleted, pinned or unpinned, with a tappable pinned-message banner.
The photo viewer supports pinch, pan, double-tap zoom and saving to the Android gallery.
Calls request audio permission correctly, clean up stale sessions and use corrected ICE/TURN candidates.
Native Android notification channels now surface new messages and incoming calls with tap-through navigation.
